name: groove
character: groove-led: drums, bass and a repeating figure carry the piece, and a hook is never required of it

focus.label: the groove itself: kick, bass and the repeating cell
focus.reason: this type is carried by rhythm and low end; demanding a melodic line would judge it as a different kind of music

pattern.loop_short.reason: a groove repeats; the variation lives in the fill and the mix, so 6 % of the bars differing is the floor

pattern.flat_dynamics.reason: a groove holds its level; energy comes from the arrangement and the accents

pattern.flags_max.reason: few parts by design, so fewer varied lines

pattern.melody_notes.reason: there is no melodic line to judge in a groove-led piece

masking.vs_melody.reason: no figure to unmask; balance.layers judges the low end against the rest
